name: Foreboding Plans
summary: The Syndicate's papers call for supplies to reach Southshore soon, where Magistrate Henry Maleb awaits them.

sections.title: The Supply List
sections.body: The Syndicate papers list food, weapons and clothing. They also call for masks, oil and poison. The supplies are needed soon for an important undertaking against Southshore. Magistrate Henry Maleb is to receive them there.

sections.title: Maleb's Verdict
sections.body: Magistrate Henry Maleb finds the documents troubling. Their words and the Syndicate's past deeds lead him to a grim judgment: the cutthroats have gone to war against the town.

faq.q: What do the Syndicate documents say?
faq.answer: The documents list food, weapons and clothing, along with masks, oil and poison. They say the supplies are needed soon for an important undertaking against Southshore.
